title: Forgotten Herald
description: A surreal scene featuring a ghostly female figure with long flowing white hair and golden tears merging with a blue heraldic shield bearing three golden pinecones and the letters 'F F'. The shield is adorned with pink and yellow foliage. In the background are ruined classical columns, broken stone architecture, pink glowing flowers, and a starry twilight sky. A yellow banner on the right reads 'FORGET' flanked by three dark birds. An ornate mirror in the foreground reflects the ghostly figure and falling golden droplets.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a translucent ghostly woman with long flowing white hair and golden tears, merging into an ornate blue heraldic shield decorated with three golden pinecones and the letters FF, surrounded by vibrant pink and yellow foliage. The scene is set among crumbling classical stone ruins and columns under a starry twilight sky with pink glowing flowers. A vertical yellow banner on the right reads 'FORGET' with three dark birds perched on it. An ornate black mirror in the foreground reflects the ghost and falling golden droplets, dark earthy tones with pops of pink and gold, melancholic and dreamlike atmosphere.
